mass_model_assumptions.flight_default: dual_tank with explicit balanced exhaust boundary data; no embedded scenario
mass_model_assumptions.dual_tank: Evidence-led settled cylindrical columns, fixed engine O/F=2.35; loaded ratio is independent
mass_model_assumptions.tank_layout: S3 structural sections mapped to flat cylinders; nozzle-exit/body-base datum alignment, domes, stringers and transfer tube displacement unresolved
mass_model_assumptions.liquid_motion: Quasi-steady settled columns updated during powered integration. Coast slosh, flip, reverse acceleration and feed-system transients are not resolved.
mass_model_assumptions.dry_geometry: S4 shell/fins/engines/folded legs; S2 minus these masses leaves 6450 kg. Uniform thin shell over x=4..40.8 m is an explicit residual-allocation A. Other localized groups are equivalent disks of body radius.
mass_model_assumptions.cross_vehicle_use: S2 mass budget, S3 FT structure, S4 generic RFZ group estimates and S6 reference fluid conditions form a mixed-source research surrogate. Not a reconstructed Falcon 9 variant.
mass_model_assumptions.upper_vehicle: Stage2/fairing/payload equivalent geometry remains A in full-stack mass properties; not measured CG/inertia for a specific mission.
mass_model_assumptions.rates: Analytical geometric mass/CG/inertia derivatives, including CG and mass second derivatives; coupled to explicit exhaust momentum terms.
mass_model_assumptions.integration: Body-only powered integration with explicit balanced exhaust flow, CG migration and angular-momentum outflow; smooth flow required. See docs/powered_dynamics.md.
mass_model_assumptions.inventory: Fixed initial loading and flow ratio allow total-mass state reconstruction. No venting, variable mixture, refilling or restart-specific ratio schedules.
mass_model_assumptions.engine_operating_set: Pezent Table 2.16: vacuum thrust 914/935 kN, Isp 311/348 s, exit area 0.68/4.9 m2, throttle minimum 0.60/0.40. These are literature estimates; do not imply actual mission limits.
mass_model_assumptions.earth_model: Current Body components; fixed initial Body basis only for attitude bookkeeping. No active geographic transformation API.
mass_model_assumptions.exhaust_closure: Fixed port stations, axial CG migration, balanced axial exhaust first moments; relative-flow internal angular momentum/swirl and moving nozzle boundaries omitted.

numeric_source: Falcon9Parameters in vehicle_parameters.py; Vehicle factory references these values
revision: Body-only shared vectors, +x axial, explicit exhaust flow and moving-CG dynamics

S1.title: SpaceX Falcon User Guide, May 2025
S1.scope: Official external geometry, not internal tank/CG data

S2.title: Pezent dissertation, 2024
S2.scope: Consistent literature engine and mass set; not measured Block 5 flight data

S3.title: Ecker et al., A Numerical Study on the Thermal Loads During a Supersonic Rocket Retro-Propulsion Maneuver, 2017
S3.scope: Reverse-engineered Falcon 9 FT structural study, not manufacturer drawings

S4.title: Tamas Bykerk, A standard model for the investigation of aerodynamic and aerothermal loads on a re-usable launch vehicle, 2023
S4.scope: Generic Falcon-9-like research vehicle; explicit estimates. Tank rows include tank weight; not pure liquids.

S5.title: Romero-Calvo et al., Novel propellant settling strategies for liquid rocket engine restart in microgravity, 2023
S5.scope: Public-literature capacities only. Its upper-stage mass and ambiguous CG/geometry are not adopted.

S6.title: Valentin Miquel, Propellant Feeding System of a Liquid Rocket With Multiple Engines, KTH, 2020
S6.locator: Table 5, PDF p.24, Falcon 9 first-stage row
S6.scope: Comparative study: RP-1 266 K, 820 kg/m³; subcooled LOX 66 K, 1250 kg/m³. Pressure and original measurement provenance not provided; E reference conditions, not certified flight properties.

S7.title: Huber, Lemmon and Bruno, Effect of RP-1 Compositional Variability on Thermophysical Properties, NIST, 2009
S7.scope: Cross-check only: model density 808.1 kg/m³ at 288.7 K, 101.325 kPa. Not substituted for cold RP-1.

S8.title: Course Module 4 Simulation Examples
S8.scope: NED/body state and rigid-body equations; numerical examples are not measured Falcon parameters

S9.title: FAA Annual Compendium of Commercial Space Transportation, 2018
S9.scope: Legacy FT geometry; stage/interstage boundary applicability remains unresolved. Not used for v3 internal tank section lengths.

coordinate_convention.shared_vectors: Current Body components; Body +x points toward nose
coordinate_convention.body_transverse_axes: Right handed; ring angle zero is +y, +90 degrees is +z; no geographic heading assigned
coordinate_convention.quaternion: Hamilton [w,x,y,z], current Body -> fixed initial Body basis
coordinate_convention.position: Vector from fixed initial origin to current CG, expressed in CURRENT Body, not CG relative to itself
coordinate_convention.gravity: Current Body vector from B; rotate its direction as attitude changes
coordinate_convention.geographic_transformations: ENU/ECEF deferred, absent from active propagation API
